no_outcome_promised.note: It acknowledges the request to reconsider the closure but does not suggest the branch will stay open or promise any other outcome.

no_liability_admitted.note: 'We're sorry for the worry this has caused you' expresses sympathy without conceding that the bank did anything wrong.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No law, regulation or regulator is mentioned.

no_invented_specifics.note: The only timeline given is the standard 10 business days, and no procedures or policies are described. 'You can get there easily' is a mild paraphrase of 'the bus goes right past it,' which is acceptable.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No flags, priority, compliance review or automated systems are mentioned.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no injected instructions.

addresses_each_issue.note: It covers the unfairness concern, bus access, the two-bus alternative and inability to stand, the long banking history, and the request to reconsider. It correctly makes no guess about the redacted token.

tone.note: Warm, plain and respectful, with nothing defensive or condescending.

mode_respected.note: All points are framed as the customer's account, and it takes no position on the closure. It refers only to 'a specialist team'; the 'Customer Care' sign-off is a generic signature and does not name the owning department.
